from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/verification')
import verify_sst_rans as v
root=Path('outputs/native-flow/sst-coupling')
r=json.loads(Path('outputs/native-flow/sst-momentum/fine-state-900/result.json').read_text())
mesh,m,meta,cells,faces,h=v.read_artifacts(Path(r['mesh']),Path(r['prefix']+'.unconverged'),diagnostic=True)
b=v.native.flow_boundaries(mesh,m,'flatplate',1.,'reject',[float(f['flux']) for f in faces],0.,'pressure-farfield')
with (root/'state.txt').open('w') as s:
 print(len(cells),len(faces),meta['nu'],file=s)
 for c in cells: print(*(c[k] for k in ('k','omega','distance','u','v')),file=s)
 for i,f in enumerate(faces):
  wall=f['wall']=='1';enter=b['roles'][i]=='inlet' or (b['roles'][i]=='farfield' and float(f['flux'])<0)
  print(f['flux'],int(wall),int(wall or enter),f['kBoundary'],f['omegaBoundary'],b['u'][i],b['v'][i],int(b['fixedU'][i]),int(b['fixedV'][i]),file=s)
(root/'input.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(r['mesh'])

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,subprocess,time,hashlib,resource,shutil
root=Path('outputs/native-flow/sst-coupling');out=root/sys.argv[1];out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
assert shutil.disk_usage('.').free>1.5*1024**3
base=json.loads((root/'input.json').read_text());mesh=Path(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else Path(base['mesh'])
cmd=[str(Path('build/cartmesh2d_sst_rans_probe').resolve()),str(mesh.resolve()),str(out/'flow'),'flatplate-sweep','--nu','2e-7','--speed','1','--inlet-k','2.25e-7','--inlet-omega','125','--leading-edge','0','--max-iterations','900','--scalar-preconditioner','ilu0','--initial-k',sys.argv[2],'--initial-omega','125']
r={'command':cmd,'meshSha256':hashlib.sha256(mesh.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'binarySha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(cmd[0]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'timeoutSeconds':90,'timedOut':False}
t=time.monotonic()
with (out/'stdout.log').open('w') as so,(out/'stderr.log').open('w') as se:
 try:r['returncode']=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=so,stderr=se,timeout=90).returncode
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:r.update(returncode=None,timedOut=True)
r['processSeconds']=time.monotonic()-t;r['maximumRssBytes']=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
f=out/'flow.diagnostics.json'
if f.exists():r['diagnostics']=json.loads(f.read_text())
(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='diagnostics'})
print((out/'stderr.log').read_text()[-2000:])
